entries.wording: Parcel is on the way to destination country
entries.note: Seen in an archived reply of GAASH's tracker; the parcel has left for Israel.

entries.wording: Ministry of Transportation
entries.note: Seen in an archived reply of GAASH's tracker; the parcel waits for a Ministry of Transport import approval before release.

entries.wording: The declaration data has been sent
entries.note: The import declaration was sent to customs.

entries.wording: Paymant is required for a transportion check
entries.note: The parcel is held until the transport ministry check is paid for; the misspellings are the reply's.

entries.wording: Storage occured - payment is required
entries.note: The parcel is held at the customs warehouse until its storage fee is paid.
